verdict.rationale: Evidence shows OpenHands can be run locally/self-hosted (Docker, VMs, or any agent server backend) as opposed to only using the managed Cloud/Enterprise offerings, and it is open-source with an SDK for building on it. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a full self-hosted setup (e.g., a third-party report of running the entire stack without cloud dependencies) and detailed self-hosting infra requirements/documentation.
